title: Choose the visual world for Ekonomika
question: The roll assigned Snickeri & Materialprov (Nordic Workshop & Ledger Sample Board). Keep it, pick an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Snickeri & Materialprov
options.lineage: Scandinavian architectural sample boards & trade studio specifications
options.thesis: Tactile Nordic craft meets calibrated accounting: every profession and service mounted like a precision workshop sample board.
options.viewport: Full-viewport architectural specification board splitting real tradespeople portraits (Byggare, Frisör, Läkare, Advokat) with a live 3-step receipt-to-ledger specimen tray and direct contact action.
options.risk: Can feel overly architectural if human warmth and personal portraits are pushed too small.

raised.raise: Unvarying structural hairline weight and tier-by-tier reading discipline across every card and frame, with zero muddy drop-shadows.
Interactive service tabs and workflow steps shift typographic weight and surface tone cohesively when inspected.
Headlines, step numerals, and marginalia lock to a strict shared baseline grid across planes.
Step numbers (01, 02, 03) and K2/K3 competence markers sit in engineered tabular numeral housings.

options.label: Årsredovisning Broadsheet
options.lineage: Swedish financial dailies & linen-bound annual reports (Årsredovisningar)
options.thesis: Turns receipt chaos into the calm, audited authority of a classic Swedish annual report and financial journal.
options.viewport: Editorial front-page spread with high-contrast serif masthead, verified trade portraits in ruled columns, and an audited summary ledger of Ekonomika's services.
options.risk: Familiar editorial-financial territory that many premium Nordic advisory firms gravitate toward.

options.label: Verifikationsband (Provenance Ribbon)
options.lineage: Archival provenance custody ribbons & verification binders
options.thesis: One continuous copper-red verification thread traces a receipt from job-site tablet to finished annual declaration.
options.viewport: An archival spread where a single red verification line enters from the top nav, threads through Byggare/Frisör/Läkare/Advokat, and knots into 01 Anslut → 02 Underlag → 03 Granska.
options.case: Dramatizes Ekonomika's receipt-to-ledger chain of custody in one unforgettable visual line; slightly more museum-editorial than everyday SMB trade.
options.risk: The ribbon must stay strictly functional as wayfinding rather than decorative string.

options.label: Grid-Disciplined Neubrutalism
options.thesis: Crisp black outlines, warm lime and forest blocks, and tactile hard-shadow buttons that snap down like mechanical keys.
options.viewport: Locked bento grid with bold grotesk headlines, color-coded trade blocks, and a tactile 3-step workflow strip with snapping CTA buttons.
options.case: Gives maximum scanability and modern fintech punch, though bolder and louder than traditional Swedish accounting firms.
options.risk: Can feel too startup-loud if color blocks overpower the calm reassurance of the copy.

options.label: Ligne Claire Album
options.thesis: Every accounting step drawn as a flat-color illustrated comic tier.
options.viewport: Four-tier waffle grid of illustrated panels showing a builder and hairdresser handing over receipts.
options.case: Comic-album framing undercuts corporate accounting credibility for K2/K3 business clients.
options.risk: Reads as a storybook rather than a qualified accounting firm.
options.kept: Unvarying structural hairline weight and tier-by-tier reading discipline across every frame.

options.label: Chromatophore Skin
options.thesis: A living surface whose typography and pigment cells expand with activity.
options.viewport: Cellular shader field pulsing across service categories.
options.case: Biological skin patterns are alien to Swedish bookkeeping and tax advisory.
options.kept: State-driven typographic weight and surface tone shifts when inspecting active workflow steps.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller Queue
options.thesis: Unboxed ivory lines floating at layered depths over an emissive black void.
options.viewport: Unenclosed baseline text over drifting starfield layers.
options.case: 2am demoscene darkness contradicts approachable daytime SME accounting.
options.kept: Shared baseline alignment across headlines, numerals, and marginalia.

options.label: Nixie Laboratory Counter
options.thesis: Every financial figure and step glowing orange inside blackened steel tube banks.
options.viewport: Bank of glowing glass numeral tubes above engraved steel service switches.
options.case: Cold-war laboratory hardware feels like an oscilloscope rather than personal advisory.
options.kept: Engineered tabular numeral housings for step numbers (01–03) and K2/K3 competence markers.

canonCard.label: Nordic Fintech & Advisory Standard
canonCard.thesis: The clean, high-trust Scandinavian accounting site visitors expect, executed at peak polish.
canonCard.viewport: Split hero with headline, CTA, and portrait alongside a 4-pillar trust bar and structured service cards.
canonCard.risk: Refines the familiar category aesthetic rather than breaking out of it.
